confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors rest on several search snippets from mixed sources (Numbeo, MyLifeElsewhere, Whereandwhen, Expatistan, Tricity guides), some crowdsourced or undated, so they are indicative. Cocktail and wine anchors are weaker: they rest on one Expatistan cocktail average, a 2024 tourist-venue wine menu and a bottle estimate, with a local price relationship to beer used as a cross-check. Local PLN prices were converted to USD at an approximate rate I did not verify by search. The July 2026 window may carry a summer tourist-zone premium, which is reflected only loosely. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge; I did not search or inspect any live listings. The FX observation (18 November 2026) comes from search results that cite the RBA exchange-rates page; I did not open the rba.gov.au page directly, and a secondary site carried the same figure. An earlier FX search returned older RBA snapshots, so the latest date should be confirmed on the official page.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used. Food and drink anchors are based on Gdansk-specific search snippets, cross-checked against Krakow and Warsaw figures where Gdansk data was thin. Accommodation anchors are general European mid-sized city estimates for a July peak season.
